<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Nine Months With You ♡</title>
<style>
:root{--ink:#563b45;--rose:#d87591;--pink:#f9e7ec;--cream:#fffaf7;--plum:#8b5269}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;overflow-x:hidden}
button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.hero{min-height:100svh;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;padding:50px 22px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,#fff 0,#fff5f6 48%,#f6e1e7 100%)}
.hero-inner{max-width:760px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.eyebrow{font:12px/1.5 Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--plum)}
h1{font-size:clamp(3rem,9vw,6.5rem);font-weight:400;line-height:.98;margin:22px 0;color:#9e536d}
h1 em{font-weight:400}
.subtitle{font-size:clamp(1.05rem,2.8vw,1.35rem);line-height:1.8;max-width:560px;margin:24px auto;color:#785965}
.primary,.soft{border:0;border-radius:99px;padding:15px 25px;background:var(--rose);color:white;box-shadow:0 8px 25px #c76c8833;transition:.2s}
.primary:hover,.soft:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);filter:brightness(.97)}
.scroll{display:block;margin:52px auto 0;color:#a66c80;font:11px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase}
.heart{position:absolute;color:#df9aae;opacity:.35;animation:float 8s ease-in-out infinite;user-select:none}
@keyframes float{50%{transform:translateY(-22px) rotate(10deg)}}
section{padding:90px 22px}
.wrap{max-width:850px;margin:auto}
.section-tag{text-align:center;color:#b56c84;font:11px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase}
h2{text-align:center;font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,3.5rem);font-weight:400;color:#99546d;margin:15px 0 30px}
.copy{font-size:1.15rem;line-height:2;text-align:center;max-width:680px;margin:0 auto;color:#70545e}
.letter-card{background:white;border:1px solid #f1dce3;border-radius:24px;padding:clamp(25px,6vw,55px);box-shadow:0 18px 55px #8d536014;max-width:720px;margin:38px auto}
.letter-card p{font-size:1.12rem;line-height:2;margin:0 0 18px}
.signature{color:#a85d78;font-style:italic;font-size:1.35rem;margin-top:28px}
.soft{background:#f5e3e9;color:#8f5269;box-shadow:none}
.center{text-align:center;margin-top:28px}
.memories{background:#fff4f6}
.memory-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:38px}
.memory{background:white;border:1px solid #f0dce2;border-radius:18px;padding:22px 18px;min-height:160px;text-align:center}
.memory .symbol{font-size:1.8rem}
.memory h3{font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:400;color:#a45d76}
.memory p{font:14px/1.7 Arial,sans-serif;color:#806a71}
.edit-note{text-align:center;font:12px/1.7 Arial,sans-serif;color:#a17b88;margin:18px auto 0}
.first-ily{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffaf8,#fff1f4)}
.first-ily-card{max-width:690px;margin:38px auto 0;padding:clamp(14px,3vw,24px);background:#fff;border:1px solid #f0dce2;border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 18px 55px #8d536014}
.first-ily-photo{display:block;width:100%;max-width:100%;height:auto;min-height:180px;object-fit:contain;object-position:center;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #e8e0e3;background:#1b1b1f}
.first-ily-caption{text-align:center;max-width:560px;margin:22px auto 5px;font-size:1.08rem;line-height:1.9;color:#765763}
.first-ily-caption em{color:#a85d78}
.favorites{background:#fff}
.favorites-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;max-width:760px;margin:38px auto 0}
.favorite-card{padding:25px 22px 27px;border-radius:20px;background:#fff6f8;border:1px solid #f2dce4;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #8d53600a}
.favorite-icon{font-size:2rem;margin-bottom:12px}
.favorite-label{font:10px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#b4778b}
.favorite-card h3{font-size:1.45rem;font-weight:400;color:#99546d;margin:10px 0}
.favorite-card p{font:14px/1.7 Arial,sans-serif;color:#806a71;margin:0 auto;max-width:260px}
.favorite-blue{background:#f1f7ff;border-color:#dceafa}
.favorite-blue .favorite-label{color:#6e91b9}
.favorite-blue h3{color:#557da8}
.favorite-blue p{color:#627b97}
.final{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#f8e8ed,#fff9f5);text-align:center}
.final h2{margin-bottom:18px}
.final p{max-width:620px;margin:0 auto;font-size:1.15rem;line-height:1.9}
.big-heart{font-size:4rem;color:#d87591;margin:24px 0;display:inline-block;animation:pulse 1.6s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{50%{transform:scale(1.13)}}
footer{text-align:center;padding:28px;color:#a7838e;font:12px Arial,sans-serif}
#surprise{display:none;margin:28px auto 0;max-width:560px;padding:25px;background:#fff;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid #f0dce2;font-size:1.15rem;line-height:1.9}
#surprise.show{display:block;animation:appear .5s ease}
@keyframes appear{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(max-width:650px){.memory-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.memory{min-height:unset}.favorites-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{min-height:92svh}section{padding:70px 20px}}

/* Her photos, scattered like a little scrapbook around the page */
section{position:relative;isolation:isolate}
.wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}
.hero-inner{z-index:2}
.scrap-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.scrap-photo{position:absolute;margin:0;padding:7px 7px 19px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #f0dce3;border-radius:5px;box-shadow:0 14px 34px #563b4524}
.scrap-photo::before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:2;top:-8px;left:calc(50% - 22px);width:44px;height:15px;background:#f2dce2;opacity:.72;transform:rotate(-5deg);clip-path:polygon(4% 0,100% 7%,94% 100%,0 92%)}
.scrap-img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:2px}
.hero .scrap-one{left:max(18px,calc(50% - 620px));top:17%;width:clamp(135px,13vw,180px);transform:rotate(-8deg)}
.hero .scrap-two{right:max(18px,calc(50% - 620px));bottom:12%;width:clamp(125px,12vw,168px);transform:rotate(7deg)}
#letter .scrap-three{right:max(16px,calc(50% - 620px));top:35%;width:clamp(115px,10.5vw,145px);transform:rotate(8deg)}
.memories .scrap-four{left:max(16px,calc(50% - 620px));top:35%;width:clamp(118px,11vw,150px);transform:rotate(-8deg)}
.favorites .scrap-five{right:max(16px,calc(50% - 620px));top:35%;width:clamp(118px,10.5vw,145px);transform:rotate(7deg)}
.mobile-collage{display:none}
@media(max-width:1200px){
  .desktop-scrap{display:none}
  .mobile-collage{display:block;position:relative;isolation:isolate;width:min(100%,760px);height:250px;margin:0 auto 12px;overflow:hidden}
  .mobile-collage .scrap-photo{width:clamp(82px,18vw,142px);padding:6px 6px 16px}
  .mobile-collage .scrap-photo:nth-child(1){left:1%;top:32px;transform:rotate(-9deg);z-index:2}
  .mobile-collage .scrap-photo:nth-child(2){left:19%;top:61px;transform:rotate(7deg);z-index:4}
  .mobile-collage .scrap-photo:nth-child(3){left:38%;top:17px;transform:rotate(-5deg);z-index:3}
  .mobile-collage .scrap-photo:nth-child(4){left:57%;top:65px;transform:rotate(8deg);z-index:5}
  .mobile-collage .scrap-photo:nth-child(5){left:76%;top:30px;transform:rotate(-7deg);z-index:2}
  .collage-note{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:5px;text-align:center;color:#a66c80;font:10px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  .mobile-collage{height:226px;margin-top:0}
  .mobile-collage .scrap-photo{width:clamp(78px,21vw,105px);padding:5px 5px 14px}
  .mobile-collage .scrap-photo:nth-child(1){left:0;top:30px}
  .mobile-collage .scrap-photo:nth-child(2){left:18%;top:57px}
  .mobile-collage .scrap-photo:nth-child(3){left:37%;top:13px}
  .mobile-collage .scrap-photo:nth-child(4){left:56%;top:58px}
  .mobile-collage .scrap-photo:nth-child(5){left:75%;top:29px}
}


/* Anniversary song: a one-tap music welcome */
.music-gate{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10000;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:22px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,#fff 0,#fff4f6 55%,#f2dce4 100%);transition:opacity .45s ease,visibility .45s ease}
.music-gate.is-hidden{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.music-gate-card{width:min(100%,440px);padding:clamp(28px,6vw,44px) 26px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #f0dce3;border-radius:27px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 22px 65px #8d536020}
.music-gate-icon{font-size:2.4rem;color:#d87591;margin-bottom:12px}
.music-gate-kicker{font:10px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#b4778b}
.music-gate-card h2{margin:14px 0 10px;font-size:clamp(2rem,7vw,2.8rem)}
.music-gate-track{font-size:1.08rem;color:#765763;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 22px}
.music-gate-hint{font:12px/1.7 Arial,sans-serif;color:#a17b88;margin:15px 0 0}
.music-gate-later{display:inline-block;margin-top:12px;border:0;background:transparent;color:#9e7180;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;font:12px Arial,sans-serif;padding:8px 12px}
.music-dock{position:fixed;z-index:999;right:16px;bottom:16px;width:250px;padding:10px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #efdce3;border-radius:17px;box-shadow:0 12px 36px #563b452b;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateY(10px);transition:opacity .3s ease,transform .3s ease,visibility .3s ease}
.music-dock.is-visible{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translateY(0)}
.music-dock-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:2px 3px 9px;color:#8f5269;font:11px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.5px}
.music-dock-heading button{border:0;background:#f8e9ed;color:#8f5269;border-radius:50%;width:24px;height:24px;line-height:1;font:16px Arial,sans-serif;padding:0}
.music-dock iframe{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:#f7edf0}
.music-dock-link{display:block;text-align:center;margin-top:7px;color:#a66c80;font:10px Arial,sans-serif;text-decoration:none}
@media(max-width:520px){.music-dock{right:10px;bottom:10px;width:min(210px,calc(100vw - 20px));padding:8px}.music-dock-heading{font-size:10px}}

</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="music-gate" id="music-gate" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="music-gate-title">
  <div class="music-gate-card">
    <div class="music-gate-icon" aria-hidden="true">♫</div>
    <div class="music-gate-kicker">one little thing before you begin</div>
    <h2 id="music-gate-title">Our song is waiting</h2>
    <p class="music-gate-track"><strong>“Cherry Flavoured”</strong><br>by The Neighbourhood</p>
    <button class="primary" id="start-with-song" type="button">Open our little world ♡</button>
    <p class="music-gate-hint">Tap once to start the song. You can pause it whenever you like.</p>
    <button class="music-gate-later" id="open-without-song" type="button">Open without music</button>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="music-dock" id="music-dock" aria-label="Cherry Flavoured music player">
  <div class="music-dock-heading"><span>♫ Now playing · Cherry Flavoured</span><button id="hide-music-dock" type="button" aria-label="Hide music player">×</button></div>
  <iframe id="song-player" title="The Neighbourhood - Cherry Flavoured official video" src="about:blank" allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>
  <a class="music-dock-link" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Be-7rsQv9c" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open the official video on YouTube ↗</a>
</div>

<header class="hero">
  <span class="heart" style="top:12%;left:12%;font-size:35px">♡</span>
  <span class="heart" style="top:22%;right:12%;font-size:25px;animation-delay:1s">♥</span>
  <span class="heart" style="bottom:16%;left:20%;font-size:22px;animation-delay:2s">♡</span>
  <span class="heart" style="bottom:13%;right:17%;font-size:40px;animation-delay:3s">♥</span>
  <div class="scrap-layer desktop-scrap" aria-hidden="true"><figure class="scrap-photo scrap-one" aria-hidden="true"><img class="scrap-img hero-one" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" loading="lazy"></figure><figure class="scrap-photo scrap-two" aria-hidden="true"><img class="scrap-img hero-two" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" loading="lazy"></figure></div>
  <div class="hero-inner">
    <div class="eyebrow">A little something for us</div>
    <h1>9 months<br><em>of you & me</em></h1>
    <p class="subtitle">Nine months might sound like a number, but to me, it holds a hundred little moments, a thousand feelings, and one person who means so much.</p>
    <button class="primary" onclick="document.querySelector('#letter').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">Open your little surprise ♡</button>
    <span class="scroll">there's more below ↓</span>
  </div>
</header>

<div class="mobile-collage" aria-label="A collage of favourite photos"><figure class="scrap-photo mobile-photo" aria-hidden="true"><img class="scrap-img mobile-1" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" loading="lazy"></figure><figure class="scrap-photo mobile-photo" aria-hidden="true"><img class="scrap-img mobile-2" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" loading="lazy"></figure><figure class="scrap-photo mobile-photo" aria-hidden="true"><img class="scrap-img mobile-3" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" loading="lazy"></figure><figure class="scrap-photo mobile-photo" aria-hidden="true"><img class="scrap-img mobile-4" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" loading="lazy"></figure><figure class="scrap-photo mobile-photo" aria-hidden="true"><img class="scrap-img mobile-5" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" loading="lazy"></figure><div class="collage-note">a few snapshots I never get tired of ♡</div></div>

<section id="letter">
  <div class="scrap-layer desktop-scrap" aria-hidden="true"><figure class="scrap-photo scrap-three" aria-hidden="true"><img class="scrap-img scrap-three" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" loading="lazy"></figure></div>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-tag">A letter, just for you</div>
    <h2>Something I want you to know</h2>
    <div class="letter-card">
      <p>Hey, my princess,</p>
      <p>Happy 9 months. I don't think I could fit everything I feel for you into one website, or even a thousand letters, but I still wanted to try.</p>
      <p>Thank you for being part of my life. Thank you for the conversations, the silly moments, the little things you probably don't even realise I remember, and all the times you've made an ordinary day feel a little less ordinary.</p>
      <p>I know we're both still figuring things out. We're not perfect, and I don't expect us to be. What matters to me is that we keep being honest with each other, keep listening, and keep choosing kindness even on the difficult days.</p>
      <p>I hope you know that you don't have to be happy every second, have everything figured out, or be anything other than yourself around me. I care about the real you — the excited you, the tired you, the quiet you, all of it.</p>
      <p>These nine months have given me memories I'll always be grateful for. And if I could make one wish for us, it would be for more gentle days, more laughter, more little adventures, and a love that feels safe for both of us.</p>
      <p>I'm really glad our paths crossed. I'm really glad it's you.</p>
      <div class="signature">With all my love, always ♡</div>
    </div>
    <p class="edit-note">Make this even more yours: change any line that doesn't sound like something you'd naturally say.</p>
  </div>
</section>


<section class="first-ily">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-tag">A little moment I kept</div>
    <h2>The first time I said “ily”</h2>
    <p class="copy">This is where those three little letters first became part of our story.</p>
    <figure class="first-ily-card">
      <img class="first-ily-photo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="A screenshot of our early chat, from the first time I said ily" loading="lazy">
      <figcaption class="first-ily-caption">Remember this? The first time I said <em>ily</em> to you. It was such a random little moment, but somehow it became one I wanted to keep. ♡</figcaption>
    </figure>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="memories">
  <div class="scrap-layer desktop-scrap" aria-hidden="true"><figure class="scrap-photo scrap-four" aria-hidden="true"><img class="scrap-img scrap-four" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" loading="lazy"></figure></div>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-tag">The little things</div>
    <h2>My favourite kind of memories</h2>
    <p class="copy">It's usually not just the big moments. It's the tiny things that stay with me. Tap the cards and add your own memories by editing the words.</p>
    <div class="memory-grid">
      <article class="memory"><div class="symbol">☁️</div><h3>Your laugh</h3><p>The way you laugh at even the smallest things makes my day. I love seeing you happy and hearing you giggle. I’d do anything to see that smile and hear that laugh over and over again.</p></article>
      <article class="memory"><div class="symbol">🌷</div><h3>Your little ways</h3><p>The small things you do without thinking — they mean more to me than you know.</p></article>
      <article class="memory"><div class="symbol">✨</div><h3>Just being us</h3><p>Even the smallest conversation we have, no matter how small, is still my favourite part of the day.</p></article>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="favorites">
  <div class="scrap-layer desktop-scrap" aria-hidden="true"><figure class="scrap-photo scrap-five" aria-hidden="true"><img class="scrap-img scrap-five" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" loading="lazy"></figure></div>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-tag">Because the little details matter</div>
    <h2>A few of your favourite things</h2>
    <p class="copy">A few little things I remember about you — because I love learning all the details that make you, you. ♡</p>
    <div class="favorites-grid">
      <article class="favorite-card">
        <div class="favorite-icon">🌷</div>
        <div class="favorite-label">Favourite flowers</div>
        <h3>Lilies</h3>
        <p>A little reminder of the flowers that make you smile.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="favorite-card">
        <div class="favorite-icon">🎞️</div>
        <div class="favorite-label">Favourite show</div>
        <h3>Bridgerton</h3>
        <p>Your favourite world of romance, stories, and pretty little details.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="favorite-card favorite-blue">
        <div class="favorite-icon">🩵</div>
        <div class="favorite-label">Favourite colour</div>
        <h3>Light blue</h3>
        <p>Soft, pretty, and so unmistakably your kind of colour.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="favorite-card">
        <div class="favorite-icon">🎧</div>
        <div class="favorite-label">Favourite song</div>
        <h3>“Cherry Flavoured”</h3>
        <p>One of those songs I'll always associate with you.</p>
      </article>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="final">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-tag">One last thing</div>
    <h2>Before you go…</h2>
    <p>I hope this made you feel even a little bit as appreciated as you deserve to feel. Thank you for these nine months, for the memories we've made, and for being someone I'll always be grateful to know.</p>
    <div class="big-heart">♡</div><br>
    <button class="primary" id="surpriseBtn" onclick="reveal()">One tiny final surprise</button>
    <div id="surprise">If I had to choose one favourite thing about these nine months, it wouldn't be one perfect day. It would be getting to know you, little by little. Happy 9 months, bownie. Here's to whatever lovely moments come next — one day at a time. ♡</div>
  </div>
</section>
<footer>made with love, for our 9 months ♡</footer>
<script>
function reveal(){
  const box=document.getElementById('surprise');
  box.classList.toggle('show');
  document.getElementById('surpriseBtn').textContent=box.classList.contains('show')?'Read it again ♡':'One tiny final surprise';
}


// Start playback after her tap. Browsers block unexpected sound on first page load.
(function setupAnniversarySong(){
  const gate = document.getElementById('music-gate');
  const startButton = document.getElementById('start-with-song');
  const silentButton = document.getElementById('open-without-song');
  const dock = document.getElementById('music-dock');
  const player = document.getElementById('song-player');
  const hideButton = document.getElementById('hide-music-dock');

  function closeGate(){
    gate.classList.add('is-hidden');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  startButton.addEventListener('click', function(){
    // Official video from The Neighbourhood's YouTube channel.
    player.src = 'https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/8Be-7rsQv9c?autoplay=1&playsinline=1&controls=1&rel=0';
    dock.classList.add('is-visible');
    closeGate();
  });

  silentButton.addEventListener('click', closeGate);
  hideButton.addEventListener('click', function(){
    dock.classList.remove('is-visible');
    // Stop playback when the player is dismissed.
    player.src = 'about:blank';
  });

  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
